keyEvents.text: Adriano Jagusic (Panathinaikos) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Alexander Lind (Nordsjælland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Nordsjælland 0, Panathinaikos 1. Adriano Jagusic (Panathinaikos) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Elmin Rastoder following a fast break.
Substitution, Nordsjælland. Mark Brink replaces Mamadou Sadio.
Substitution, Nordsjælland. Hjalte Boe Rasmussen replaces Markus Walker.
Delay in match because of an injury Justin Janssen (Nordsjælland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Nordsjælland 0, Panathinaikos 2. Elmin Rastoder (Panathinaikos) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Adriano Jagusic.
Goal! Nordsjælland 1, Panathinaikos 2. Alexander Lind (Nordsjælland) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ibrahim Adel.
Substitution, Panathinaikos. Levi García replaces Andrews Tetteh.
Substitution, Panathinaikos. Vicente Taborda replaces Adriano Jagusic.
Substitution, Panathinaikos. Imrân Louza replaces Kings Kangwa.
Substitution, Nordsjælland. Runar Norheim replaces Nicklas Røjkjær.
Justin Janssen (Nordsjælland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Panathinaikos. Victor Kristiansen replaces Facundo Pellistri.
Own Goal by Victor Kristiansen, Panathinaikos. Nordsjælland 2, Panathinaikos 2.
Goal! Nordsjælland 3, Panathinaikos 2. Alexander Lind (Nordsjælland) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Hjalte Boe Rasmussen with a through ball.
Substitution, Panathinaikos. Cyriel Dessers replaces Triantafyllos Tsapras.
Hjalte Boe Rasmussen (Nordsjælland) is shown the yellow card.
